architecture.rationale: Clear feature/modules split with MVVM, Hilt DI, Supabase backend. Invoice generation integrated into approval flow. Configurable bank details from Supabase app_config table. Verified via src/ layout and SupabaseRepository.kt.

code_quality.rationale: Consistent style, configurable bank details from Supabase. Some hardcoded fee amounts remain. Verified via search_files and read_file.

security.rationale: No service_role key in client. RLS policies present with is_admin() function. Input sanitization via InputSanitizer. Encrypted SharedPreferences. Bank details configurable from Supabase. No certificate pinning, no MFA. Verified via grep and read_file.

testing.rationale: 10 test files, 159 tests. All passing after testOptions fix (unitTests.isReturnDefaultValues = true). No auth/role-gate tests. No integration/E2E tests. Verified via testDebugUnitTest and XML results.

documentation.rationale: Comprehensive README with setup, architecture, database tables, backup strategy, fee structure. Verified via read_file README.md.

deployment.rationale: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline. Supabase keep-alive ping. Backup strategy documented. Self-updater with GitHub Releases. Verified via .github/workflows/ and README.md.

performance.rationale: ~10MB APK. Realtime subscriptions for messaging. No obvious memory leaks. Cold start acceptable. Verified via APK size and code inspection.

maintainability.rationale: Clear module structure with Hilt DI. Configurable bank details and fees from Supabase. Consistent naming. Verified via src/ layout.

critical.title: Mock bank details still in app_config table
critical.problem: The app_config table in Supabase contains mock bank details (First National Bank, Account 62845679012, Branch 250655). These are the default values that show until the user updates them.
critical.impact: Parents will see mock bank details until the user updates the app_config table with real values. Payments will fail if parents use these details.
critical.evidence: Verified — app_config table created with mock values as defaults. RegistrationPaymentScreen.kt and FinancePaymentScreen.kt load from app_config but fall back to mock defaults if config is missing.
critical.action: Update the app_config table in Supabase with real business bank details. The app will automatically use the new values without requiring an app update.

important.title: No monthly fee calculation system
important.problem: There is no system to calculate or generate monthly school fees, transport fees, or aftercare fees. Only registration and transport invoices are auto-generated on approval.
important.impact: School cannot automate monthly billing. Aftercare and stationery fees must be created manually. Parents never receive recurring monthly invoices for these.
important.evidence: Verified — no fee calculation logic exists in codebase. InvoiceCategory enum has REGISTRATION, AFTERCARE, TRANSPORT, STATIONERY but only registration and transport are auto-generated.
important.action: Build a fee calculation system: define fee structure per grade, generate monthly invoices on a configurable date, track due dates and overdue status.

important.title: No auth/role-gate tests
important.problem: No tests verify that parent role cannot access admin screens or vice versa. RouteGuard and RequireParent/RequireAdmin are untested.
important.impact: Role-based access control regressions would ship unnoticed. Security-critical authorization logic is unverified.
important.evidence: Verified — test files cover data models, repository, input sanitizer, routes. No test references RouteGuard, RequireParent, RequireAdmin, or role-based access.
important.action: Add tests for RouteGuard: verify parent cannot navigate to admin routes, verify admin cannot navigate to parent routes, verify unauthenticated users are redirected.

important.title: No payment reminder notifications
important.problem: No system to send automated payment reminders before due date or after overdue status.
important.impact: Parents may forget to pay. No automated follow-up for overdue payments.
important.evidence: Verified — no notification generation logic exists for payment reminders.
important.action: Add payment reminder notifications: send before due date and after overdue via Supabase notifications.

improvements.title: Add certificate pinning for Supabase API
improvements.action: Use OkHttp CertificatePinner with Supabase API fingerprint to prevent MITM attacks.

improvements.title: Add MFA for admin accounts
improvements.action: Enable TOTP in Supabase Auth for admin role to prevent unauthorized access.

improvements.title: Add date filters to admin finance tabs
improvements.action: Allow admin to filter payments/invoices by date range for better management.

improvements.title: Add export functionality for payment records
improvements.action: Allow admin to export payment records to CSV for accounting.

improvements.title: Add late payment penalty calculation
improvements.action: Automatically calculate and apply late payment penalties after due date.
